verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims users can "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks," which is a first-party claim of recurring, background automation. That is the only mention: there are no docs on how to set up workflows, what they can do, or how they run unattended. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of workflow/automation setup, details on schedule configuration and background execution behavior, scope of what automations can trigger (e.g., MCP tools/agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
